allocationRule: Allocate all available cash across1to3 qualifying choices, leaving lot/fee remainder; later entries use remaining cash and unused slots. Never force negative-net forecasts or count waiting cash as success.
exitRule: Price reaches the frozen model expected 20-session target. New purchases cannot be sold the same day (T+1). No forced exit at the thirty-minute boundary. Each symbol bought at most once. No human discretionary trades.
notes: All transactions virtual; no broker account or actual fills.
Source heartbeat is not a trade timestamp.
Cash zero is not a successful price forecast.
This added target-exit policy has no validated performance; it is not the old four fixed-holding observations.
The forecast horizon is twenty sessions, not thirty minutes.
Fixed commission assumption may differ from an actual contract. Last-price fills do not model order-book queues or liquidity.
